review: 702.47d-1: B's response was written into the base expected text and the decisions left B's choice open; moved the Unsummon cast into the decisions and the variant delta.

702.47e-1: polarities were inverted (the plain recast is the rule's effect, losing the spliced text); set recast_plain to fires and recast_spliced_again to other, and noted that 702.47e has no does_not_fire case.

scenarios.title: A spliced spell gains the card's text, the splice cost is paid and the card stays in hand

setup.notes: Reach Through Mists is a blue Arcane instant that draws a card. Glacial Ray has splice onto Arcane {1}{R} and deals 2 damage to any target.

decisions: A casts Reach Through Mists, revealing Glacial Ray to splice it onto the spell, and chooses Grizzly Bears as the target of the spliced text.
A pays {U} with the Island and the splice cost {1}{R} with both Mountains.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: spliced
variants.expected: All three lands are tapped. Reach Through Mists resolves: A draws Forest and Grizzly Bears is dealt 2 damage and moves to B's graveyard. Glacial Ray is still in A's hand. Reach Through Mists moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: not_spliced
variants.delta: A does not reveal Glacial Ray and pays only {U} with the Island.
variants.expected: Only the Island is tapped. Reach Through Mists resolves: A draws Forest. Grizzly Bears is undamaged on the battlefield and Glacial Ray is in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge represents a spliced spell by adding the spliced abilities to the spell on the stack.

scenarios.title: A card cannot be spliced onto a spell when its targets cannot be chosen

setup.notes: Goryo's Vengeance has splice onto Arcane {2}{B} and targets a legendary creature card in the caster's graveyard. Isao, Enlightened Bushi is legendary.

decisions: A casts Reach Through Mists and offers to splice Goryo's Vengeance onto it, targeting the legendary creature card in A's graveyard.
A pays {U} with the Island and the splice cost {2}{B} with the three Swamps.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: legal_target
variants.expected: Splicing Goryo's Vengeance is legal. Reach Through Mists resolves: A draws Forest and Isao, Enlightened Bushi moves from A's graveyard to the battlefield under A's control with haste. Goryo's Vengeance is still in A's hand.

variants.label: no_legal_target
variants.delta: The creature card in A's graveyard is Grizzly Bears (not legendary) instead of Isao, Enlightened Bushi.
variants.expected: Splicing Goryo's Vengeance is not legal because it has no legal target. Only Reach Through Mists can be cast, for {U}; A draws Forest and Grizzly Bears stays in the graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Goryo's Vengeance exiles the returned creature at the beginning of the next end step.

scenarios.title: Several cards can be spliced onto one spell and each adds its own effect

setup.notes: Craw Wurm is a 6/4. Each Glacial Ray deals 2 damage to any target.

decisions: A casts Reach Through Mists, revealing both Glacial Rays at once to splice them onto the spell, and orders the effects with Reach Through Mists first, then the Rays.
Both spliced texts target Craw Wurm.
A pays {U} with the Island and each splice cost {1}{R} with two Mountains.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: two_rays
variants.expected: Reach Through Mists resolves: A draws Forest first, then Craw Wurm is dealt 2 damage twice and moves to B's graveyard. Both Glacial Rays are still in A's hand.

variants.label: one_ray
variants.delta: A splices only one Glacial Ray and pays {U}{1}{R}, leaving two Mountains untapped.
variants.expected: Reach Through Mists resolves: A draws Forest and Craw Wurm is dealt 2 damage once and stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked. Both Glacial Rays are still in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: The same Glacial Ray card cannot be spliced twice onto one spell; only the two distinct copies are used here.

scenarios.title: A spliced spell keeps the main spell's color, so protection is checked against the main spell

setup.notes: Knights of Thorn is a 2/2 with protection from red (and banding, which is inert here). Reach Through Mists is blue and Lava Spike is red.

decisions: A casts Reach Through Mists, splicing Glacial Ray onto it and choosing Knights of Thorn as the target of the spliced text.
A pays {U} with the Island and the splice cost {1}{R} with both Mountains.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: blue_main_spell
variants.expected: Knights of Thorn is a legal target for the spliced text because the spell is blue. Reach Through Mists resolves: A draws Forest and Knights of Thorn is dealt 2 damage and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: red_main_spell
variants.delta: A casts Lava Spike (red) as the main spell, targeting B, and splices Glacial Ray onto it instead of Reach Through Mists.
variants.expected: Knights of Thorn is not a legal target for the spliced text because the spell is red. Knights of Thorn stays on the battlefield undamaged; the spliced text can target only B or other permanents.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the red_main_spell variant A pays {R} for Lava Spike with one Mountain and the splice cost {1}{R} with the other Mountain and the Island.

scenarios.title: A spell whose only targets come from spliced text does not resolve when they become illegal

setup.notes: Reach Through Mists has no target of its own.

decisions: A casts Reach Through Mists, splicing Glacial Ray onto it with Grizzly Bears as the target of the spliced text, paying {U} with the Island and {1}{R} with both Mountains.
B casts Unsummon targeting Grizzly Bears, paying {U} with B's Island. Both players pass; Unsummon resolves.
Both players pass; Reach Through Mists resolves or is removed from the stack.

variants.label: target_removed
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears moves to B's hand. Reach Through Mists does not resolve because its only target is illegal: it fizzles, A does not draw and Reach Through Mists moves to A's graveyard. Glacial Ray stays in A's hand.

variants.label: target_stays
variants.delta: B passes priority instead of casting Unsummon.
variants.expected: Reach Through Mists resolves: A draws Forest and Grizzly Bears is dealt 2 damage and moves to B's graveyard. Unsummon stays in B's hand.

scenarios.title: A spell loses its spliced text once it leaves the stack
decisions: A casts Reach Through Mists splicing Glacial Ray onto it with Grizzly Bears as the target of the spliced text, paying {U} with an Island and {1}{R} with two Mountains. Both players pass; it resolves.
A casts Regrowth targeting Reach Through Mists in A's graveyard, paying {1}{G} with both Forests. Both players pass; it resolves and Reach Through Mists returns to A's hand.
A casts Reach Through Mists again, paying {U} with the second Island.

variants.label: recast_plain
variants.expected: The first cast resolves: A draws a Forest and Grizzly Bears moves to B's graveyard. The second cast resolves: A draws another Forest and nothing is dealt damage; Savannah Lions is undamaged on the battlefield. Glacial Ray is still in A's hand.

variants.label: recast_spliced_again
variants.delta: On the second cast A also splices Glacial Ray again, targeting Savannah Lions, and pays {1}{R} with the two remaining Mountains.
variants.expected: The second cast resolves: A draws a Forest and Savannah Lions is dealt 2 damage and moves to B's graveyard. Glacial Ray is still in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Reach Through Mists must be a fresh object after Regrowth returns it; the second library draw requires at least two cards in A's library. 702.47e always applies once the spell leaves the stack, so the scenario has no does_not_fire variant.
